card.text: Smaller partner of Patroclus in a binary pair of Jupiter Trojans.

introduction.text: Menoetius measures about 117 by 108 by 90 km, and circles Patroclus every 4.28 days.

model.title: Occultation shape approximation
model.summary: A 117 × 108 × 90 km ellipsoid from occultations and light curves; local shape and surface are not resolved.
